## Outcome
A coding agent that has never seen this workspace can enumerate and operate the entire pm capability set from a single screen of help output, and every historical spelling keeps working.

## Why this is a milestone, not an epic
pm-n7rr is the living execution epic (partition of consolidation tasks). This milestone is the outcome gate: it declares when the grammar work is done enough to freeze, which is the precondition the GA stability contract (pm-agou) consumes.

## Delivery chain
pm-pbyu (ADR, accept first) -> pm-0z7n (alias shim foundation) -> the consolidation partition under pm-n7rr (pfqi/kcs4/tqel/yql1/tnud/6apl/xkgq/ik19/eq4x/o3fh/npr3/lp4j/szdc) -> pm-e2bq tiered help -> pm-8pnj transcript replay proves the outcome.

## Explicit non-goals
No capability removal. No breaking rename without an alias. No grammar freeze here — freezing is pm-agou's job.
Outcome milestone: agent-legible command grammar — one-screen surface, zero feature loss, alias-preserved

Top-level command count meets the pm-pbyu ADR target with zero capability removed; Every pre-consolidation spelling resolves via the alias shim with a one-line migration hint; Golden agent-transcript replay shows a measured tokens-per-completed-task reduction versus the pre-consolidation baseline; Tiered help renders the full core surface in one screen; pm help --all remains complete
A coding agent operates every pm capability from one screen of help without out-of-band context
Cuts the dominant agent onboarding cost: today's ~70 top-level commands force out-of-band documentation reads before the first useful call.
Every agent invocation in every downstream workspace gets cheaper; the grammar freeze in the GA contract depends on this landing first.
Top-level noun count at or below the ADR target, every retired spelling still functional as a hidden alias, and a measured drop in tokens-per-completed-task.
The surface is still growing (graph, plan, merge, history-* families all landed post-v0.1). Consolidating later means freezing more aliases forever.
